subject: Upcoming Company Event: Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Employee Appreciation Day event on Friday, May 28th. Join us for a day of fun activities, games, and a special lunch to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. We value each one of you and look forward to showing our appreciation. Please RSVP by May 20th. We can't wait to celebrate together! Best regards, HR Team
